description: Exploratory project applying mathematical analogies (information theory, optimal transport, path signatures, Bayesian inference) alongside standard meta-analytic methods to clinical evidence synthesis.
status: Exploratory; not a validated tool for clinical decision-making.
frameworks_deployed: Bayesian Model Averaging over FE / DL / REML / PM (BIC weights)

key_metrics.note: All metrics are dataset-dependent. Re-run the scripts on the configured TMAL_DATA_DIR to regenerate. The original portfolio analysed ~2,900 trials, but the loaded set may differ after filtering.
